exposure: Goal-directed fluid therapy (GDFT) with LiDCO<inf>rapid</inf> system
outcome: Umbilical artery and vein blood pH
cohort: The study included 100 healthy term parturient women scheduled for elective cesarean section.
finding: Goal-directed fluid therapy significantly reduced the incidence of maternal hypotension and vasopressor doses, and improved umbilical blood gas parameters in newborns compared to routine fluid therapy.
